title: Forest and River
lead: One of the best natural retreats for recharging with fresh air, clean water, and pure quiet.
body:
Symphony of Green and Blue

The Drawa Forest is an area where forests and water form an inseparable system. It is a land where silence is not the absence of sound, but the presence of nature in its most authentic form.

The trails of Drawa National Park lead through regions where humans are rare guests. When you walk through dense woods and then step out onto the bank of a crystal-clear river, you can feel tension disappearing with every breath and the mind becoming clear and calm.

The Rhythm of a Forest Bivouac

Slow travel in the Drawa Forest is above all about returning to basics. It is a river float at a pace that lets you notice every bird and every leaf, and an overnight stay in a quiet forest campsite, where the only alarm clock is birdsong at dawn.

Instead of looking for attractions, it is worth simply being in this forest. Watching how light filtered through the treetops paints strange patterns on the ground, and feeling that the greatest luxury is the ability to be completely out of reach of the network and noise.
tip: Try to organize a bivouac in one of the designated quiet zones. It is an experience that allows for a complete reset and return to inner balance.
